short_description: This category means the image may show normal skin or a condition that the AI model cannot identify with enough certainty. It should not be considered a final diagnosis.
temporary_advice: Use a clear, well-lit image for better analysis
Monitor any skin change over time
Avoid scratching or irritating the area
Keep the skin clean and moisturized
Consult a dermatologist if symptoms persist or worsen
avoid: Do not rely only on AI if symptoms are concerning
Avoid using random treatments without advice
Do not ignore pain, bleeding, fever, or rapid spread
risk_notes: Unknown or normal output means the AI is uncertain or sees no obvious abnormality. Medical advice is needed if symptoms are persistent, painful, spreading, bleeding, or changing.
when_to_see_doctor: If there is pain, bleeding, fever, or pus
If a mole changes shape, size, or color
If you are worried or unsure
